function.description: The ONE way to ask the OWNER for a decision, or to record the owner's answer to an open ask. question=… raises (any session, never a leaf); with options=[…] in a live owner turn it waits and returns the pick. answer=… decides (a genuine owner turn only). In an autonomous (goal/cron) run, a decision you need from the owner is an owner_ask, never a question in a message.
function.name: owner_ask

answer.description: ANSWER (owner turn only): the owner's decision, QUOTED from their message in this turn (e.g. "A"). Words that are not in the owner's message are refused.

ask_id.description: ANSWER: the ask to decide. Omit when exactly one ask is open.

blocks_goal_ids.description: RAISE: goals to HOLD until the owner answers, then re-arm. A run may hold only its own goal. Never waits in this turn.

holds_this_job.description: RAISE, in a scheduled job's run only: True HOLDS this job (no run) until the owner answers or the ask expires. Use it when every run is pointless until the answer.

options.description: RAISE: 2 to 6 short options (each at most 80 characters). In a live owner turn the owner gets buttons or a numbered prompt and this call WAITS and returns the pick. In an autonomous run they become tap answers on the durable ask.

question.description: RAISE: the decision or resource you need from the owner, as ONE question answerable in a word or two. Durable, deduplicated, shown on every owner seat; the answer reaches this rail's next run. In an autonomous run, never ask this in a message instead.

wait_seconds.description: RAISE with options, live owner turn: how long to wait for the pick.
